🧾 Thermal Receipt Print Format & Design

              
Updated 30 Sep 2026 — single-bill printing and isolated thermal pages

              

                Choose your preferred layout format for thermal receipt printing (80mm / 58mm roll paper). Includes Table-Grid Invoice style.
              

              

                
                
              

              

                
                
                
                
                
                
              

              
Browser: select the matching roll paper, scale 100%, margins None, and turn headers/footers off. Desktop ESC/POS: text size selects the nearest built-in printer font; spacing and margins assume a 203dpi printer. Graphic template styles apply to browser printing.

              
              
Browser printing uses one receipt-only document. For one bill/cut choose Customer only, and set printer driver copies to 1, cut after document, and no extra feed. Customer + Kitchen uses one browser print job with both copies together. The printer driver controls browser cutting.


              

                
                
              

              


              

                
                

                  
📊 1. Table-Grid Invoice

                  
Full table borders around items, header & totals summary. Ideal for structured bills.

                


                
                

                  
📄 2. Classic Minimalist

                  
Standard thermal paper look with dashed lines & clean spacing.

                


                
                

                  
🏷️ 3. Modern Dark Banner

                  
Bold black header banner, dark totals block & high-contrast section badges.

                


                
                

                  
✒️ 4. Formal Elegant

                  
Double-ruled dividers, serif text & polite customer footer.

                


                
                

                  
⚡ 5. Eco-Save Compact

                  
Reduced row padding to save paper on 58mm or 80mm rolls. Your line-spacing setting is respected.

                🥘 Manage Kitchen Stock Items
              

              

                📦 Add New Stock Item
              

              

              

                
                
              


              

                

                  
                  
                

                

                  
                  
                

              


              
              

                
                
                

                  You buy this by weight but use it by the piece, so the app
                  needs to know roughly what one piece weighs — otherwise it
                  can't work out how much stock an order uses. A rough figure is
                  fine: it's refined automatically from the "Total Number of
                  Pieces" you enter on each purchase.
                

              


              

                If Bought and Sold units are the same, no conversion is needed.
                If they differ, the grams-per-piece figure above is refined
                automatically from the "Total Number of Pieces" you log with
                each purchase.
